plan.line: a DS3231 real-time clock module (I2C): keeps the date and time accurately (about a minute a year), even while the Pico is unplugged (on its coin cell). Use it for clocks, alarms and timetables that must keep running without Wi-Fi. Uses one I2C bus (at most 2 I2C parts).

code.pinLine: DS3231 real-time clock {ref} on I2C{bus} (SDA {gpio}, SCL {scl}): i2c{n} = I2C({bus}, sda=Pin({g}), scl=Pin({sclG}), freq=400000) and clock{n} = DS3231(i2c{n}). clock{n}.time() gives (year, month, day, hour, minute, second), 24-hour. clock{n}.set_time(year, month, day, hour, minute, second) sets it: only do that once (or behind a button), or it resets to the same time on every start. clock{n}.temperature() is the chip's temperature in C.
code.moduleRule: ds3231 when a real-time clock is listed
